cards.name: Osseous Exhale
cards.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, you may behold a Dragon. (You may choose a Dragon you control or reveal a Dragon card from your hand.)
Osseous Exhale deals 5 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If a Dragon was beheld, you gain 2 life.

cards.name: Savior of the Small
cards.oracle_text: Survival — At the beginning of your second main phase, if this creature is tapped, return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Blessing of the Nephilim
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 for each of its colors.

cards.name: Call a Surprise Witness
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a flying counter on it. It's a Spirit in addition to its other types.

cards.name: Case of the Pilfered Proof
cards.oracle_text:
Whenever a Detective you control enters or is turned face up, put a +1/+1 counter on it.
To solve — You control three or more Detectives. (If unsolved, solve at the beginning of your end step.)
Solved — If one or more tokens would be created under your control, those tokens plus a Clue token are created instead. (It's an artifact with "{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.")

cards.name: Imperial Lancer
cards.oracle_text: This creature has double strike as long as you control a Dinosaur.

cards.name: Pride of the Road
cards.oracle_text:
Vigilance
Start your engines! (If you have no speed, it starts at 1. It increases once on each of your turns when an opponent loses life. Max speed is 4.)
Max speed — At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature or Vehicle you control gains double strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Dwarven Castle Guard
cards.oracle_text: When this creature dies, create a 1/1 colorless Hero creature token.

cards.name: Veil of Assimilation
cards.oracle_text: Whenever this artifact or another artifact you control enters, target creature you control gets +1/+1 and gains vigilance until end of turn.
